Figure 5. CAM-associated metabolic profiles

  • Input files
  • Plot settings
  • A–B. Procrustes alignment and metabolite differences
  • C. GAM predictions
  • D–E. Top pathways and figure assembly
  • Session information

These are final plotting tables for Procrustes alignment, metabolite comparisons, GAM predictions and KEGG pathways. No PCA, GAM or enrichment model is refitted here. The KEGG results were generated with minGSSize = 10; bubble size represents Count.

Open this file in RStudio and click Knit, or run rmarkdown::render("fig5/fig5.Rmd") from the repository root. Keep the CSV files beside this Rmd. PDF and PNG files are written to the same folder.

Input files

File
differential_metabolites.csv
gam_predictions.csv
kegg_pathways.csv
procrustes_coordinates.csv
procrustes_statistics.csv

Plot settings

library(ggplot2)
## Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.4.3
library(patchwork)
## Warning: package 'patchwork' was built under R version 4.4.3
read_data <- function(name) {
  raw_lines <- readLines(name,warn=FALSE,encoding="bytes")
  enc <- if (all(validUTF8(raw_lines))) "UTF-8" else "GB18030"
  read.csv(name,check.names=FALSE,fileEncoding=enc,encoding="UTF-8")
}
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=8,base_family="Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),panel.border=element_rect(colour="black",fill=NA,linewidth=.7),
        legend.position="bottom",strip.background=element_rect(fill="grey94",linewidth=.3)))
save_plot <- function(p,name,width,height) {
  
  ggsave(paste0(name,".pdf"),p,device=cairo_pdf,width=width,height=height,units="mm",limitsize=FALSE)
  ggsave(paste0(name,".png"),p,device=ragg::agg_png,width=width,height=height,units="mm",dpi=300,limitsize=FALSE)
}

A–B. Procrustes alignment and metabolite differences

a<-read_data("procrustes_coordinates.csv");s<-read_data("procrustes_statistics.csv")
p_a<-ggplot(a)+
 geom_segment(aes(x=Metabolome_PC1,y=Metabolome_PC2,xend=Microbiome_PC1,yend=Microbiome_PC2),colour="grey80",linewidth=.25)+
 geom_point(aes(Metabolome_PC1,Metabolome_PC2,shape="Metabolome"),colour="#DFB99B",fill="white",size=1.7,stroke=.35)+
 geom_point(aes(Microbiome_PC1,Microbiome_PC2,shape="Microbiome"),colour="#8FA7BB",fill="#CAD9E5",size=1.8,stroke=.35)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(Metabolome=23,Microbiome=24))+labs(title="(A) Procrustes analysis",
 subtitle=sprintf("r = %.3f; PROTEST P = %.4f; n = %d",s$Procrustes_r,s$PROTEST_P,s$N),x="PC 1",y="PC 2",shape=NULL)
b<-read_data("differential_metabolites.csv");b<-b[order(b$Log2FC),];b$Metabolite<-factor(b$Metabolite,levels=b$Metabolite)
label_colours<-ifelse(b$Highlighted,"#D62728","black")
p_b<-ggplot(b,aes(Log2FC,Metabolite))+geom_col(fill="steelblue",width=.8)+
 geom_vline(xintercept=0,colour="grey40",linewidth=.25)+
 geom_text(aes(x=Log2FC+ifelse(Log2FC>=0,.12,-.12),label=Stars),size=2.5)+
 scale_y_discrete()+scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=.12),breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(5))+
 labs(title="(B) Fecal metabolite differences",x=expression(log[2]*" fold change"),y=NULL)+
 theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=6,colour=label_colours),axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
## Warning: Vectorized input to `element_text()` is not officially supported.
## ℹ Results may be unexpected or may change in future versions of ggplot2.
save_plot(p_a,"figure5A",140,110)
save_plot(p_b,"figure5B",180,145)

C. GAM predictions

d<-read_data("gam_predictions.csv");d$Metabolite<-factor(d$Metabolite,levels=unique(d$Metabolite));d$Group<-factor(d$Group,levels=c("w/o","w/"))
p_c<-ggplot(d,aes(Time,Fit,colour=Group))+geom_line(linewidth=.5)+
 facet_wrap(~Metabolite,nrow=1,scales="free_y",labeller=as_labeller(function(x) vapply(x,function(y) paste(strwrap(gsub("-","- ",gsub(",",", ",y)),width=23),collapse="\n"),character(1))))+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c("w/o"="#F8766D","w/"="#00BFC4"))+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=0:3,limits=c(0,3))+
 labs(title="(C) GAM model predictions for differential metabolites",x=NULL,y="Standardized abundance",colour="Group")+
 theme(strip.text=element_text(size=5.5),axis.text=element_text(size=6),legend.position="right")
save_plot(p_c,"figure5C",300,80)

D–E. Top pathways and figure assembly

Within each module, significant pathways (BH-adjusted P < 0.05) from either group were ranked by the smaller group-specific adjusted P value, with ties resolved by KEGG ID. Up to eight unique pathways are displayed; FM1 has four. Original statistics are unchanged. All modules share the same colour scale (adjusted P 0–0.05) and size scale (Count 2–12).

k <- read.csv("kegg_pathways.csv",check.names=FALSE)
k$Group <- factor(k$Group,levels=c("w/o","w/"))
kegg_theme <- theme_bw(base_size=9,base_family="Arial")+
          theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),panel.border=element_rect(colour="black",fill=NA,linewidth=.7),
                legend.position="right")
count_limits <- range(k$Count)
count_breaks <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12)
count_breaks <- count_breaks[count_breaks >= count_limits[1] & count_breaks <= count_limits[2]]
make_kegg <- function(module) {
 d <- k[k$Module==module,];d <- d[order(d$Display_rank),]
 d$Description <- factor(d$Description,levels=rev(unique(d$Description)))
 ggplot(d,aes(Group,Description,colour=p.adjust,size=Count)) +
   geom_point() +
   scale_colour_gradient(low="#EF767B",high="#BFBBBA",limits=c(0,.05),
                         breaks=c(0,.025,.05),labels=c("0","0.025","0.05")) +
   scale_size_continuous(range=c(2,5),limits=count_limits,breaks=count_breaks) +
   scale_x_discrete(drop=FALSE,expand=expansion(add=.65)) +
   scale_y_discrete(labels=function(x) vapply(x,function(s) paste(strwrap(s,width=36),collapse="\n"),character(1))) +
   labs(title=module,x=NULL,y=NULL,colour="Adjusted P",size="Count") +
   guides(colour=guide_colourbar(order=1),size=guide_legend(order=2)) +
   kegg_theme + theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),axis.text.x=element_text(size=9),
         legend.text=element_text(size=7),legend.title=element_text(size=8),
         plot.title=element_text(size=11,face="bold",hjust=.5),
         legend.key.height=grid::unit(4,"mm"),legend.key.width=grid::unit(3,"mm"),
         plot.margin=margin(5,5,5,5))
}
p_d <- wrap_plots(lapply(paste0("BM",1:4),make_kegg),ncol=2)+plot_annotation(title="(D) Bacterial CAM-associated pathways")
p_e <- wrap_plots(lapply(paste0("FM",1:4),make_kegg),ncol=2)+plot_annotation(title="(E) Fungal CAM-associated pathways")
save_plot(p_d,"figure5D",300,205)
save_plot(p_e,"figure5E",300,205)
for (mod in unique(k$Module)) save_plot(make_kegg(mod),paste0("figure5_",mod),155,105)
save_plot(wrap_elements(full=p_d)/wrap_elements(full=p_e),"figure5DE",300,410)
# Assemble the original A–C panels with the updated D–E panels.
top <- p_a+p_b+plot_layout(widths=c(1,1.3))
p_all <- wrap_plots(top,p_c,wrap_elements(full=p_d),wrap_elements(full=p_e),ncol=1,heights=c(1.2,.7,2,2))
save_plot(p_all,"figure5",310,520)
